lines.en: Lesson 23
lines.zh: 第23课

lines.en: Bird flight
lines.zh: 鸟的飞行

lines.en: What are the two main types of bird flight described by the author?
lines.zh: 作者描述的鸟类飞行的两种主要类型是什么？

lines.en: No two sorts of birds practise quite the same sort of flight;
lines.zh: 没有两种鸟的飞行方式是完全相同的；

lines.en: the varieties are infinite; but two classes may be roughly seen.
lines.zh: 种类是无限的；但大致可分为两类。

lines.en: Any ship that crosses the Pacific
lines.zh: 任何一艘横渡太平洋的船只

lines.en: is accompanied for many days by the smaller albatross,
lines.zh: 会有较小的信天翁伴随数日，

lines.en: which may keep company with the vessel for an hour
lines.zh: 它们可以陪伴船只一个小时

lines.en: without visible or more than occasional movement of wing.
lines.zh: 翅膀几乎不动或只是偶尔动一下。

lines.en: The currents of air that the walls of the ship direct upwards,
lines.zh: 船体向上引导的气流，

lines.en: as well as in the line of its course,
lines.zh: 以及沿其航线的气流，

lines.en: are enough to give the great bird with its immense wings
lines.zh: 足以为这种有着巨大翅膀的大鸟

lines.en: sufficient sustenance and progress.
lines.zh: 提供足够的升力和前进动力。

lines.en: The albatross is the king of the gliders,
lines.zh: 信天翁是滑翔之王，

lines.en: the class of fliers which harness the air to their purpose,
lines.zh: 这类飞行者利用空气达到目的，

lines.en: but must yield to its opposition.
lines.zh: 但也必须屈服于空气的阻力。

lines.en: In the contrary school, the duck is supreme.
lines.zh: 在相反的学派中，鸭子是至高无上的。

lines.en: It comes nearer to the engines with which man has 'conquered' the air, as he boasts.
lines.zh: 它更接近于人类声称“征服”天空的发动机。

lines.en: Duck, and like them the pigeons, are endowed with steel-like muscles,
lines.zh: 鸭子，以及像它们一样的鸽子，都拥有钢铁般的肌肉，

lines.en: that are a good part of the weight of the bird,
lines.zh: 这些肌肉占据了鸟类体重很大一部分，

lines.en: and these will ply the short wings with such irresistible power
lines.zh: 它们以不可抗拒的力量挥动短小的翅膀，

lines.en: that they can bore for long distances through an opposing gale
lines.zh: 可以在逆风中飞行很长的距离

lines.en: before exhaustion follows.
lines.zh: 而不致精疲力尽。

lines.en: Their humbler followers, such as partridges,
lines.zh: 它们较小的追随者，例如鹧鸪，

lines.en: have a like power of strong propulsion, but soon tire.
lines.zh: 也有类似的强大推进力，但很快就会疲劳。

lines.en: You may pick them up in utter exhaustion,
lines.zh: 你可能会发现它们筋疲力尽，

lines.en: if wind over the sea has driven them to a long journey.
lines.zh: 如果海上的风迫使它们长途跋涉。

lines.en: The swallow shares the virtues of both schools in highest measure.
lines.zh: 燕子则兼具这两种飞行的优点，而且达到了最高境界。

lines.en: It tires not, nor does it boast of its power; but belongs to the air
lines.zh: 它不疲倦，也不炫耀自己的力量；它属于天空，

lines.en: travelling it may be six thousand miles to and from its northern nesting home,
lines.zh: 也许飞行六千英里往返于它的北方巢穴，

lines.en: feeding its flown young as it flies, and slipping through a medium
lines.zh: 边飞边喂养已经出巢的幼鸟，滑过介质

lines.en: that seems to help its passage even when the wind is adverse.
lines.zh: 即使逆风，这介质似乎也在帮助它通过。

lines.en: Such birds do us good,
lines.zh: 这样的鸟对我们有益，

lines.en: though we no longer take omens from their flight on this side and that;
lines.zh: 尽管我们不再从它们飞行的方向来卜吉凶；

lines.en: and even the most superstitious villagers no longer take off their hats to the magpie and wish it good-morning.
lines.zh: 甚至最迷信的村民也不再向喜鹊脱帽致意并祝它早上好。
